definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.delaunay_generator, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: H. C. Wente, 'Counterexample to a conjecture of H. Hopf', Pacific J. Math. 121 (1986).
R. Walter, 'Explicit examples to the H-problem of Heinz Hopf', Geom. Dedicata 23 (1987) -- the elementary parametrisation used here (supplement 6.B').

caveats: The counterexample to Hopf's conjecture that the only closed CMC surface is the round sphere. Immersed, not embedded -- Alexandrov had already proved no EMBEDDED counterexample can exist.
